tokenName: African Development Partners AgriVenture Warehouse Token
description: African Development Partners invests venture capital in agricultural technology and warehousing startups in Zambia. regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: African Development Partners Future of Work VC Token

description: African Development Partners backs startups building the future of work infrastructure in Zambia: gig economy platforms, digital labour marketplaces, skills credentialing apps and informal sector digitisation tools. regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: African Development Partners GreenBuild VC Token

tokenName: African Development Partners Labor-Tech Venture Token
